about:
Engineered Medical Systems, Inc. was founded in 1985 in Indianapolis, Indiana, as a privately held medical device manufacturer. The company later expanded to a second facility in Penang, Malaysia, with both sites holding ISO 13485 certification.

The company designs and manufactures disposable air management devices and electronic medical devices. Its capabilities span product design from concept through prototype and tool building, injection molding and complete assembly, bonding via sonic welding, solvents and adhesives, product testing, and finished-device delivery. Operations occupy more than 100,000 square feet of manufacturing space across the Indianapolis and Penang facilities.

Engineered Medical Systems serves the medical device industry, supplying disposable air management products and electronic medical devices to specialty distributors and international markets in over 70 countries. The company also collaborates with brands such as Pulmodyne for innovative product submissions.

The company emphasizes a robust quality program, engineering-driven innovation, and regulatory compliance support as core differentiators, aiming to help clients achieve ISO standard compliance from concept to market.
